purpose: What only a person can know or decide (PROJECT.md P22, FR-48). A question to a person names ONE class; anything else the conductor settles itself.

classes.says: access or data the person can give: a credential, a stand, a file, a source the factory's own probe could not reach WITH what it has (P5, FR-50); never what the factory's probe proved unreachable for good (D-0043)
what a requirement or the ticket means when the requirements are silent, or contradict each other or the code (P20, P23)
budget, spend, a cap the person sets (story budget, rerun price)
a risk to the product or the process the person owns: a dirty tree, a branch, a stand mutation, a regression scope
an action that leaves the project: a tracker write, an MR, a publication
a team convention, priority or business context only the team knows (where tests live, what a story is for)
a judgment only a person makes, or makes faster and cheaper (P19 step 4)
the word that passes a gate or a block (P13, FR-4)
